newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says yen rate in line with fundamentals -Jiji.
newsitem.headline: MOF says yen rate in line with fundamentals -Jiji.

text.p: The current yen exchange rate is in line with economic fundamentals, Jiji news agency quoted Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka as saying on Thursday.
"A view that foreign exchange rates reflect fundamentals is a widely held one. (The present level of the yen exchange rate) is such a one," Jiji quoted Mitsuzuka as telling a parliamentary committee.
Mitsuzuka's comment was in response to a question over the movement of yen exchange rates following the meeting of the Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations earlier this month.
